decisions: The brief fits the bounded format: it specifies a 36-second, 1920×1080, 30 fps, silent, screenshot-led launch video using supplied product screens and a final Kujo bumper. It is benefits-first, introduces rather than teaches installation, limits claims to supplied evidence, forbids invented metrics and captions/scene labels, preserves the required visual order, and identifies the result as a local review candidate rather than an automatic publication. Narration is clearly context-only, with timing explicitly unverified.
stopCondition: Required artifact or review capability missing
